_readme: The hook database (copy-playbook.md Part 1). One entry = one hook CONCEPT expressed on three surfaces: caption (post line 1, <=100 chars), reel.line1/line2 (the video's first frame, <=18/<=28 chars), headline (burned on the card, <=64 chars). {placeholders} are filled ONLY from real auction/graph fields — the honesty rule applies to every string here. Edit this file, then run: python marketing/gen_hook_doc.py  (regenerates docs/marketing/hook-database.md). The Poster injects the relevant pillar's entries into its prompt as the HOOK ARSENAL.
